name: Qube templates
description: This is the place where software in Qubes OS is installed (root filesystem).

subtechniques.name: Clone template
subtechniques.description: In Qubes OS, templates might be cloned to work with. The templates themselves are left alone and additional packages are only installed in the cloned template. The cloned template may become an App qube based on the cloned template, optional: make this App qube a disposable.

subtechniques.name: Split SSH
subtechniques.description: If untrusted qubes in QubesOS require access to SSH keys, split-SSH from freshly qubes might be used.
